description: This file defines the MysqlSource class, which extends BackupSource, and manages MySQL database backup operations including connection setup, stage management, and SQL statement generation.

classes.name: MysqlSource
classes.description: A class for managing MySQL database backups, including connection setup, stage progression, and SQL statement generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MysqlSource object with database configuration and sets up the connection.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Establishes database connection and sets session variables.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next backup stage and retrieves associated data.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if there are more stages to process.

methods.name: getNextStage
methods.description: Determines the next stage based on current stage.

methods.name: getStageData
methods.description: Retrieves data relevant to the current stage.

methods.name: initTableList
methods.description: Fetches list of table names from the database.

methods.name: setCurrentTable
methods.description: Sets the current table for backup operations.

methods.name: getInsertStatement
methods.description: Generates SQL insert statements for table data.

methods.name: getTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL statement to create a table.

methods.name: getInsertNames
methods.description: Generates the list of column names for insert statements.

methods.name: getInsertValues
methods.description: Generates the values part of insert statements.

methods.name: checkError
methods.description: Checks for SQL execution errors and throws exceptions if any.
